profile_name: D1 candidate — melee wound-overflow cap ON (the shipped default)
description: The shipped default, stated explicitly so the paired evaluator has a candidate file to point at. Melee damage in excess of a model's Wounds characteristic is discarded, matching what RulesEngine actually resolves and what the ranged estimator has always done. Measured by tests/test_ai_combat_math_property.gd: with the cap the Big choppa predicts 3.472 against a 3.554 sampled mean (2.3%); without it, 8.333 against 2.805 (3.0x).
